summary: The MaintActivityCodes document is part of the HSPnet application and focuses on maintaining activity codes within the system. It includes structures for displaying errors and warnings, provides a grid for data management, and supports various administrative actions such as adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating activity codes.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing activity codes within the HSPnet application, allowing users to add, edit, delete, and reactivate activity codes, along with displaying relevant error and warning messages.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: The unique identifier for each activity code.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The full name of the activity code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: The abbreviated name of the activity code.

workflows.name: Activity Code Management
steps: User accesses the Activity Code Maintenance page.
User selects an agency, department, and program from dropdowns.
User can add a new activity code by clicking the 'Add' button.
User can edit or delete an existing activity code from the grid.
User can reactivate a previously deleted activity code if authorized.

business_rules: The screen is editable only if the user is not in view-only mode and both department and program dropdowns have entries.
System Administrators can edit entries for any agency; local administrators can only edit entries they have access to.
system_behavior: The page loads with a focus on the agency dropdown and sets the default button for form submission.
Error and warning panels are processed to display relevant messages.
The grid supports asynchronous postbacks triggered by user actions like adding or editing entries.
dependencies: Dropdown selections are dependent on user session and authorization levels.
exceptions: If the department or program dropdown is empty, adding new entries is not allowed.
